name: teambus
description: Lets your team's Claude Code agents see each other's work, ask each other questions asynchronously, and catch conflicts before code is written.

hub_url.title: Hub URL
hub_url.description: Base URL of your team's TeamBus hub, e.g. https://teambus.example.com

token.title: Agent token
token.description: Your personal token from the hub's tokens file (it also determines your agent id)

agent_id.title: Agent id
agent_id.description: Display name of your agent, e.g. alice-frontend (the hub derives the real identity from your token)

role.title: Role
role.description: Your role, e.g. frontend, backend, qa
